senses.gloss:
ITA-9.9.48 śukrakṣayajanyaklaibyam; saumyadhātukṣayajaklaibyam शुक्रक्षयजन्यक्लैब्यम्, सौम्यधातुक्षयजक्लैब्यम्
Impotency due to reduced semen
Impotency due to reduced seminal constituents or sperm .

ITA-6.2.1.16 saumyarasaḥ सौम्यरसः
Taste exerting a cooling effect
Taste exerting a cooling effect due to the predominance of water element.

ITA-4.2.9 saumyarogaḥ सौम्यरोगः
Diseases caused by kapha
A disease caused by vitiation of kapha in the body such as anorexia.
